title: org-config-mcp-credential-parts-v1
description: An org config whose MCP server credential has two secret parts (AM-C20, CONNECTORS-PLAN.md), as pushed to the gateway: Datadog's DD-API-KEY in the secret's own in, name and value, and DD-APPLICATION-KEY in parts. The shape is the OrgConfig definition of the admin contract; this file only points at it, so the two can never drift. Resolve the reference by registering ../agentcc-admin.schema.json under its $id. mcp.servers.<id>.credential.secret exists only in pushed payloads, never in a saved config. The gateway applies parts with its credential templates (CN7): it accepts this push when its connector catalog declares datadog/vendor-mcp with these two secret parts, and refuses it otherwise (400 mcp_credential_placement_unsupported, param mcp.servers.datadog.catalog_ref).
